content.text: We hate talking about money.
Right, so don't ask somebody their salary or how much money they make.
content.trans: 是的，所以不要问某人薪水或他们赚多少钱。

content.text: It's just not considered to be polite.
And another good one to be careful of is asking if someone is married or not.
content.trans: 另外，要小心的是，问一个人是否已婚或未婚。

content.text: Right, sometimes you're just being friendly and you want to know if that person has family
content.trans: 是的，有时候你只是出于友好和好奇想知道那个人是否拥有家人。

content.text: or something, but you have to be careful when and where you ask this question.
content.trans: 或者，但你必须小心在何时和何处提出这个问题。

content.text: Right, so if they've mentioned their family, if they've talked about their kids or something
content.trans: 是的，如果他们提到他们的家庭、孩子或其他相关话题。

content.text: else to do with their family, then it's okay.
content.trans: 另外，与家庭有关的事情，那么就OK。

content.text: Right, you can say, oh, how long have you been married?
content.trans: 是的，你说得对。你是不是已经结婚了呢？

content.text: Yeah.

content.trans: 但是，如果一个男人问一个女人或者你结婚了，这听起来有点像是可能他对你有兴趣。
